description: Recommended `skillOverrides` patch for ~/. Post-orchestrator (2026-08-25): the six auto-mainline entries, the L12 narrow skills and both hidden safety gates were deleted with their subsystems; keep_on now carries only genuinely standalone skills.

visibility_legend.on: Name + description in Claude context; appears in / menu. (platform default)
visibility_legend.name-only: Name only in Claude context; `Skill(name)` dispatch STILL WORKS; appears in / menu.
visibility_legend.user-invocable-only: Hidden from Claude context; appears in / menu (user can invoke).
visibility_legend.off: Hidden from Claude context; hidden from / menu.

policy.why: Two hard limits apply to the listing (docs/native-capabilities.md 'Skill listing budget'): 1,536 chars per skill and 1% of the context window overall. Over budget the platform keeps names and drops descriptions starting with the least-invoked skills — silently. A description is only worth its budget when Claude must recognise the skill UNPROMPTED. An orchestrator-dispatched sub-skill does not qualify: the orchestrator's own body carries the routing table, and dispatch keeps working at name-only.
policy.evidence: Measured 2026-08-04: of a 173-entry listing, 112 rendered as bare names while only 38 were our own name-only choices — the rest were budget-dropped, including three of the four skills CLAUDE.md §3 excludes from name-only precisely because they must self-trigger. A controlled overlay (166 forced to name-only) restored descriptions to all four, proving name-only returns its chars to the shared budget. Full method + honesty boundaries: tests/orchestrator-routing/RESULTS-2026-08-04.md.
policy.generated_by: tools/skill-visibility/generate.js  (recommended_overrides is COMPUTED; the three lists below are hand-owned)

keep_on.guide: Top-level user guide for this config. No orchestrator dispatches it, and it answers 'how do I use this' — needs to be recognisable unprompted.
keep_on.arch-viz: Standalone: nothing in skills/ or agents/ dispatches it. Answers 'visualize the architecture' directly.
keep_on.codegraph-cli: Standalone: nothing in skills/ or agents/ dispatches it. Answers 'who calls X / blast radius' directly.
keep_on.codex-dispatch: Standalone: nothing in skills/ or agents/ dispatches it. Owns cross-model delegation, referenced by rules/common/task-execution-protocol.md as a trigger-word skill.
keep_on.workflow-creator: Standalone: nothing in skills/ or agents/ dispatches it; the user asks for a workflow in plain language.

manual_gates.anchor-prototype-wave: Multi-surface production wave with parallel subagents. Expensive; requires explicit user trigger.
manual_gates.brutalist-skill: Experimental L3 style — requires explicit user opt-in by name.
manual_gates.output-skill: Requires explicit user opt-in by name.

merge_strategy.preferred:
node claude-config.js skills            (dry-run diff vs live settings.json)
node claude-config.js skills --apply    (additive merge into ~/.claude/settings.json)
merge_strategy.manual: Open ~/.claude/settings.json, locate top-level `skillOverrides`, merge entries from `recommended_overrides`. Additive merge — do not blind-replace keys you did not review.
merge_strategy.rollback: claude-config.js backs settings.json up before writing. Dated fallbacks live in ~/.claude/backups/<date>/.

known_limits: skillOverrides lives in live settings.json, a `claude-config.js` PRESERVE key — it is not distributed by install.sh/.ps1. Without the `skills` subcommand this list does not survive a reinstall or a new machine (ledger [ctx-1]).

The dispatched-vs-standalone split behind keep_on is substring matching over referencing files, so it errs in both directions: `guide` matched the ordinary English word and was rescued by hand. Re-derive it with `node tools/skill-visibility/generate.js --audit` and read the output; treat the result as reviewed-by-human, not proven.

CORRECTED 2026-08-04: the first pass scanned only the orchestrators' SKILL.md and references/, so it missed dispatch from agents/. `motion-engineering` (dispatched by agents/uiux-surface-builder.md) and `discoverability-growth` (dispatched by agents/disc-measurement-puller.md) were wrongly listed as standalone and have been moved out of keep_on. --audit now scans skills/, agents/ and commands/.
